test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.**

After having worked on the study non-stop for twenty-three years, Harvey finally** __called it a day__** last week.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1) i.e. "Stopped working on something".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Called it a day: **This means to stop working on something, especially after a long period of work. (किसी चीज पर काम करना बंद कर देना) 

 
 
• **Example**: After eight hours of continuous work, she decided to call it a day. 
 
 
 
• **Stopped working on something: **(काम करना बंद कर दिया) - To cease the action or task that one has been doing. 
 
 
• **Example**: After trying for hours to fix the car, he finally stopped working on it. 
 
 
 
• This fits the sentence context as Harvey stopped working on his study after twenty-three years of continuous effort. 

**Therefore, the correct answer is *"Stopped working on something".***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Started a new job:** (नई नौकरी शुरू की) - To begin employment at a new place. 
 
• **Honed a new skill:** (एक नई क्षमता को पैना किया) - To improve and refine a particular skill. 
 
• **Decided to revise:** (संशोधित करने का निर्णय लिया) - To change or amend something based on further considerations.

13d:T9ea,

The correct answer is **Option 2.**
